Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding kickoff + missing PO token / spend cap question

Hi Lukas —

We're finalizing the paperwork for Redwood and ran into a couple of friction points before we can start provisioning the first month's usage:

- There isn't a visible PO number on the vendor portal for our activation (our finance team expects a purchase reference/token to map invoices).
- The quoted spend cap of $12,000 wasn't applied in the portal and invoices are being flagged for review.

Attached our filled onboarding form (fathom_onboarding_form_v3.pdf) and a quick spreadsheet of expected SKUs. Can you confirm whether procurement at Redwood issues a provisional PO token, or should we supply a reference from our side?

Also, one of the line items needs to be split across two SKUs (Platform + 24/7 Support) but appears as a single bundled SKU in your catalog; we'll need that corrected for internal GL mapping.

Thanks — appreciate a target timeline so our billing team can proceed.

— Elena Park
Head of Platform Ops, Fathom Labs

Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff + missing PO token / spend cap question

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the forms and the line-item spreadsheet. Quick update and proposed next steps so we don't block your provisioning: 

1) Provisional PO token: Procurement can issue a provisional purchase reference (PO token) tied to deal DL-1129. Marcus (cc'd) will generate that token and drop it into our vendor ledger; that should allow your invoicing to map immediately.

2) Spend cap: Grace (cc'd) will confirm application of the $12,000 monthly spend cap in our billing rules. If there's a timing lag between the token issuance and the cap application we'll treat it as a billing exception to avoid invoice rejections.

3) Line item split: Please highlight which rows in requested_line_items.xlsx should be split (Platform vs Support). If you can mark the target SKU codes I can ask catalog ops to issue the split and create two separate ledger lines so your GL aligns.

Action owners and ETA: Marcus to issue token by EOD today; Grace to confirm cap within 24 hours; Lukas to kick off catalog ticket after you mark the spreadsheet.

I'll follow up when Marcus posts the token.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Vendor Enablement — Redwood Inference

Issuing provisional token now. Details:

- PO token: RWI-2026-PROV-1129-T1
- Token type: provisional (procurement-issued); valid for 45 days for initial invoices
- Spend cap flag: set to $12,000/mo on the billing record for Fathom Labs (will reflect in next sync, ~30 minutes)
